episodes.synopsis: High school student Seiji Sawamura loves to fight. Because of this, girls never go near him. But one day, his right hand suddenly became a girl!
episodes.title: The Right-Hand Girlfriend

episodes.synopsis: Seiji is trying to cope with Midori being his right hand. However, thugs from another school arrive to fight.
episodes.title: The Love Between Us

episodes.synopsis: Seiji's sister comes to visit. His sister's street gang arrive also and decide to go to a bathhouse.
episodes.title: The Day of Discoveries

episodes.synopsis: Midori dirtied her clothes with ice cream. Seiji decides to get her new clothes at a doll shop and ends up running into a classmate there.
episodes.title: Discovery of the Secret!?

episodes.synopsis: Seiji was absent from P.E. due to an injury. He managed to get home, but accidentally drank alcohol and is now passed out.
episodes.title: The Power of Love

episodes.synopsis: On a Sunday morning, Seiji decides to take care of his neighbor, Shiori Tsukishima.
episodes.title: Shiori's Love-Love Battle!

episodes.synopsis: Ayase convinces Seiji to the movies, but he is unaware that it is a date. Midori appears not to mind…
episodes.title: First Date

episodes.synopsis: Midori and Seiji have switched! Seiji is now on the right hand of Midori!
episodes.title: Right-hand Seiji

episodes.synopsis: Shuichi Takamizawa, Seiji's classmate, has been taking pictures of Midori and uploading it onto a website.
episodes.title: Takky Days

episodes.synopsis: Osamu Miyahara sets up a meeting with Seiji. Midori doesn't like the situation. Moreover, Ayase arrives not knowing Seiji was there.
episodes.title: Distance of the Hearts

episodes.synopsis: Seiji and Midori play a game where the loser has to listen to whatever the winner wishes.
episodes.title: Fated Reunion

episodes.synopsis: Kouta learns of Seiji and Midori's secret. If he tells Midori's family, she can become regular size again. However, Seiji is refusing…
episodes.title: Sudden Parting

episodes.synopsis: Seiji's right hand returns to normal. Midori is no longer there. Ayase confesses her feelings, but it is unrequited…
episodes.title: Our Days
